mutant.original: 'a batch has a version, a list of steps and a client id'
mutant.lineText: if (typeof batch !== 'object' || batch === null || !Number.isInteger(batch.version) || !Array.isArray(batch.steps) || typeof batch.clientID !== 'string' || !ID.test(batch.clientID)) return this.reject('bad-request', 'a batch has a version, a list of steps and a client id');
mutant.nextText: if (batch.steps.length > this.o.maxBatch) return this.reject('too-many-steps', `at most ${this.o.maxBatch} steps in a batch`);
